title: Advice from My Sister

pre.en: What did Lily do to her flatmate?
pre.zh: Lily 对她的室友做了什么？
options: She sent her a long message at midnight.
She wrote a cleaning plan for her.
She talked to her face to face.

intro: 一段兄妹之间的电话：Chen 跟室友 Tom 闹翻了，打电话向在医院上夜班的妹妹 Lily 求助。读的时候留意 should have 和 shouldn't have：事情已经做了、改不了了，人们怎么后悔，又怎么数落别人——还有，嘴快的妹妹是怎么给建议的。

sentences.en: I'm on my break, so I've got ten.
sentences.zh: 我正好在休息，有十分钟。
sentences.speaker: Lily

sentences.en: He leaves dirty pans in the sink for days, and it really gets on my nerves.
sentences.zh: 他老把脏锅扔在水槽里，一放就是好几天，烦死我了。
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: I've been doing all the cleaning on my own.
sentences.zh: 打扫卫生一直是我一个人在干。

sentences.en: So last night I sent him a long message.
sentences.zh: 所以昨晚我给他发了一条长消息。

sentences.en: You shouldn't have sent that message at midnight.
sentences.zh: 你就不该大半夜发那条消息。

sentences.en: You should have talked to him face to face.
But he should have washed those pans days ago!
sentences.zh: 可那些锅他好几天前就该洗了！
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: Maybe, but he's been working twelve-hour shifts all month.
sentences.zh: 也许吧，可他这一个月天天上十二个小时的班。
sentences.speaker: Lily

sentences.en: Don't take it personally — he's exhausted, not lazy.
sentences.zh: 别往心里去——他是累坏了，不是懒。

sentences.en: I should have waited for a better moment.
sentences.zh: 我应该找个更合适的时候再说。

sentences.en: Well, you should make up with him before the weekend.
sentences.zh: 那你赶在周末之前得跟他和好。
sentences.speaker: Lily

sentences.en: Why don't you two sort out a cleaning plan?
sentences.zh: 要不你们俩排个打扫计划？

sentences.en: Then you could tidy up the kitchen together.
sentences.zh: 然后一起把厨房收拾一下。

sentences.en: Then you should apologise for the capital letters.
sentences.zh: 那你就该为那些大写字母道歉。
sentences.speaker: Lily

sentences.en: I knew I could count on you for a pep talk.
sentences.zh: 我就知道找你准没错，你最会给人打气了。

sentences.en: My flatmate's been eating my yoghurt for weeks, so last night I sent her a very long message.
sentences.zh: 我室友偷吃我的酸奶好几个星期了，所以昨晚我给她发了一条超长的消息。

sentences.en: You shouldn't have sent that message at midnight.
sentences.zh: 你就不该大半夜发那条消息。

cards.note: to argue with someone and stop being friendly with them
cards.tip: 过去式 fell out，过去分词 fallen out；闹翻的原因用 over 或 about：fall out with sb over money。
cards.example: She fell out with her manager over the new deadline.

cards.note: 这个意思读 /raʊ/，和 cow 押韵；读 /rəʊ/ 是「一排」。have a row with sb 跟某人吵架。
动词 sink 是「下沉」：The boat sank。
to annoy someone, especially by doing something again and again
cards.tip: sb's 要换成具体的人：gets on my nerves、gets on her nerves；主语是让人烦的那个人或那件事。
cards.example: The noise from the building site is starting to get on my nerves.

cards.note: alone, or without help from anyone
放在名词前要加连字符：a face-to-face meeting。

cards.zh: 往心里去；觉得是冲着自己来的
cards.note: to feel that someone's words or actions are an attack on you, when they may not be
cards.tip: 多用在否定句里：Don't take it personally（别往心里去）；中间的 it 不能省。
cards.example: The client didn't like the design, but don't take it personally.

cards.note: 比 tired 程度重得多；前面不再加 very，要加强就说 completely exhausted。

cards.zh: 明白某人的意思；觉得某人说得有道理
cards.note: to understand why someone thinks something, and accept that they may be right
cards.tip: 常用来先认同、再说不同意见：I see your point, but …；「同意你的观点」不说 agree your point。
cards.example: I see your point, but we still need to finish the tests first.

cards.note: to become friends with someone again after an argument
cards.tip: 正好是本课 fall out with 的反义；后面不跟人时直接说 make up：They've made up.
cards.example: Have you made up with your brother yet?

cards.note: to organise something that is untidy, or to deal with a problem
cards.tip: 既能说「整理东西」，也能说「解决问题、安排好」；代词放中间：sort it out。
cards.example: Let's sort out the release plan before Friday.

cards.note: to make a place clean and neat by putting things where they belong
cards.tip: 英式英语常用，美式更常说 clean up；代词放中间：tidy it up。
cards.example: Can you tidy up your desk before the client visits?

cards.note: used to say that the answer will change because of something else
cards.tip: 单独用就是「看情况」；说看什么用 on：It depends on the weather。不说 It's depends。
cards.example: Will the update take long? — It depends on the network.

cards.note: 也叫 capitals 或 caps；小写字母是 small letters 或 lower case。
to say sorry for something you have done
cards.tip: 向谁道歉用 to：apologise to Tom for the message。英式拼写 apologise，美式 apologize。
cards.example: I apologise for the late reply — I was on holiday.

cards.note: to trust someone to help you or to do what they have promised
to say that you hope someone will be successful
英式拼法 yoghurt，美式 yogurt；一盒酸奶是 a pot of yoghurt。
